signed_rows.behavior: the receiver starts, serves the webhook endpoint and stays up when NATS is unreachable
signed_rows.fails_when: the receiver exits, or does not answer on its port, while NATS cannot be reached

signed_rows.behavior: a publish failure makes the receiver answer the webhook with a non-2xx status at once and keep running
signed_rows.fails_when: the answer is 2xx, takes longer than the webhook's 10 s timeout, or the receiver exits

signed_rows.behavior: the receiver refuses a request with a missing or wrong bearer token and publishes nothing for it
signed_rows.fails_when: such a request gets 2xx or reaches JetStream

signed_rows.behavior: the receiver publishes each accepted event to the stream with a Msg-Id derived from the event, so a redelivered webhook dedupes
signed_rows.fails_when: an event is published without a Msg-Id, or the same event gets two different ids

signed_rows.behavior: the consumer acts on the object's current state, not the event type: an existing object is written to OpenViking with content/write and wait true, a missing one is deleted
signed_rows.fails_when: a delete event for an object that exists again causes a delete, a create event for a gone object causes a write, or batch-write is used

signed_rows.behavior: the consumer maps <owner>/<repo>/<path> to viking://user/jasper/resources/projects/<repo>/<path>, ignores _state/ keys and skips unmapped prefixes
signed_rows.fails_when: a URI is wrong, a _state/ key reaches OpenViking, or an unmapped prefix is written

signed_rows.behavior: the consumer acks a message only after OpenViking accepts, retries with backoff, and moves it to the dead-letter subject after N failed tries
signed_rows.fails_when: a message is acked before success, is retried without bound, or is dropped without reaching the dead-letter subject

signed_rows.behavior: under a burst of 200 events the consumer never has more OpenViking requests in flight than its pool size
signed_rows.fails_when: the observed in-flight count exceeds the configured pool size

signed_rows.behavior: the consumer deletes an emptied OpenViking folder with recursive=true only when ls with hidden files shows nothing but .abstract.md and .overview.md, and judges removal by ls
signed_rows.fails_when: a recursive delete runs on a folder holding any other entry, or removal is judged by fs/stat

signed_rows.behavior: the catch-up pass writes a bucket file missing from OpenViking and deletes an OpenViking file whose object is gone
signed_rows.fails_when: either difference survives a catch-up pass

signed_rows.behavior: the repo gates pass, including the new go vet and go test hooks and Terraform fmt and validate

after apply, mc cp of a .md file to ov-sync/JasperHG90/localstack/docs/ is readable at viking://user/jasper/resources/projects/localstack/docs/ within 60 s and mc rm removes it within 60 s, also when OpenViking is stopped during the copy and started five minutes later
signed_rows.fails_when: either takes 60 s or more, or the file is lost or left behind across the OpenViking outage

signed_rows.behavior: in seaweedfs.hcl the receiver is a prestart sidecar that owns the static ports and the seaweedfs service and check, SeaweedFS joins it with network_mode task:receiver, the restart block allows at least three attempts, the receiver's token template is change_mode noop with a memory limit with headroom; after apply, nomad alloc restart of the seaweedfs task alone leaves the alloc running and S3 answering
signed_rows.fails_when: any of these is missing in the jobspec, or the live restart fails the alloc

signed_rows.behavior: the decision record (naming the rejected gocdk_pub_sub path and the rejected listener on radxa), the components page, placement and the NATS reference describe what was built
signed_rows.fails_when: a page is missing or disagrees with the jobs and stream as built
